overall_assessment: Talen Energy's disclosure corpus contains no climate emissions pledge, net-zero commitment, or emissions reduction targets; the climate-relevant text is limited to regulatory compliance discussions (RGGI, EPA GHG rules, CCR/ELG rules) with no voluntary ambition, specificity, time-horizon structure, mechanism clarity, or verification/governance framework evident.

ambition.reasoning: No net-zero, carbon-neutral, or emissions-reduction commitment of any kind appears in the corpus. References to GHG are exclusively in the context of regulatory compliance risk (EPA GHG Rule, RGGI) rather than voluntary pledges.
